subject.title: fix(gateway): recover when suppressed channel secrets are unavailable

question: Should breaker-suppressed startup omit channel SecretRef assignments while preserving their source configuration, and should this PR be the canonical implementation instead of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106405?
rationale: Both candidates are proof-positive, but selecting the permanent owner boundary and accepting startup-only channel-secret suppression is a security and lifecycle policy choice that automation should not make.

options.title: Select this PR
options.body: Approve the startup-only boundary, refresh this branch against main, land it, and close the competing implementation.

options.title: Select the competing PR
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106405 as the landing candidate and close this PR after confirming equivalent recovery and fail-closed coverage.

options.title: Reject secret suppression
options.body: Keep the issue open and redesign safe mode if channel SecretRefs must remain fail-closed even when channel autostart is already suppressed.

recommendation.title: Select this PR
recommendation.body: Approve the startup-only boundary, refresh this branch against main, land it, and close the competing implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the breaker and documented its control-plane-safe suppression semantics.
